title: Pistachio Baklava
description: An exquisite Turkish pastry made with delicate layers of filo, premium pistachios, clarified butter, and fragrant syrup, baked until deeply golden and irresistibly crisp.

instruction.title: Prepare the Syrup
steps: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle boil and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in rose water.
Cool the syrup completely.

instruction.title: Prepare the Pastry
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C.
Brush a baking tray generously with clarified butter.
Lay one filo sheet into the tray and brush lightly with butter.
Repeat for approximately 8 to 10 layers.

instruction.title: Add the Pistachios
steps: Spread a thin, even layer of chopped pistachios over the filo.
Add several more buttered filo sheets.
Repeat the pistachio and filo layers until the ingredients are used.
Finish with 8 to 10 buttered filo sheets on top.

instruction.title: Cut and Bake
steps: Using a sharp knife, cut the baklava into diamonds or rectangles before baking.
Pour the remaining clarified butter evenly across the surface.
Bake for approximately 40 to 50 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.
Rotate the tray halfway through baking if necessary.

instruction.title: Finish With Syrup
steps: Remove the hot baklava from the oven.
Immediately pour the completely cooled syrup evenly over the pastry.
Allow the baklava to rest for at least 4 hours.
Garnish each piece with finely ground pistachios before serving.

servingSuggestions.title: Luxury Dessert Presentation
items: Garnish with finely ground premium pistachios.
Add a small scoop of plain kaymak for an elevated presentation.

chefTips: Keep filo covered with a slightly damp towel while working so it does not dry out.
Use clarified butter for a cleaner, richer flavor and crispier layers.
Brush each layer lightly rather than flooding it with butter.
Cool the syrup completely before pouring it over the hot baklava.
Allow several hours of resting time for the syrup to distribute properly.
Premium pistachios make a major difference in flavor and appearance.
Bake until deeply golden; pale baklava will lack the desired caramelized flavor.
